title: Upload and share project files
summary: Select a project with --project P or its checkout mapping and hold items.write before uploading. --path names the project-relative address; uploading there again replaces the bytes. The returned URL opens for a signed-in reader with items.read or a script using its connection token. Local links require that universe to be serving. The guide owns path rules, size limits and named refusal recovery.
verification: Source/help inspection only; no upload or live receipt. Retention remains unresolved: the public guide says no expiry while CLI help says hosted files expire after 365 days. Both claims predate this source relocation; this map certifies no file lifetime.
